header: Using an OpenSearch Ingestion pipeline with Amazon DynamoDB
content:
You can use the DynamoDB plugin to stream table events, such as creates, updates, and deletes, to
Amazon OpenSearch Service domains and Amazon OpenSearch Serverless collections. The pipeline
uses change data capture (CDC) for high-scale, low-latency streaming.
You can process DynamoDB data with or without a full initial snapshot.
Amazon DynamoDB
149
Amazon OpenSearch Service
Developer Guide
• With a full snapshot – DynamoDB uses point-in-time recovery (PITR) to create a backup and
uploads it to Amazon S3. OpenSearch Ingestion then indexes the snapshot in one or multiple
OpenSearch indexes. To maintain consistency, the pipeline synchronizes all DynamoDB changes
with OpenSearch. This option requires you to enable both PITR and DynamoDB Streams.
• Without a snapshot – OpenSearch Ingestion streams only new DynamoDB events. Choose this
option if you already have a snapshot or need real-time streaming without historical data. This
option requires you to enable only DynamoDB Streams.
For more information, see DynamoDB zero-ETL integration with Amazon OpenSearch Service in
the Amazon DynamoDB Developer Guide.
